timing_boundary: The row target is sent before world.step. Contact callbacks record native contact data during that step. Contact manifold positions/separations and poststep rigid poses must not be assumed exactly simultaneous.

unknown: Which native constraint or mesh/contact point dominates the transient.
Whether smaller closure speed would avoid it.
